Topography displays interpolated elevation contours at 50 m intervals, with major contours every 250 m.Hazards classify maximum local neighboring slopes into three categories: above 10° to 18° (amber), above 18° to 22° (orange-red), and above 22° (dark red). Geology shows interpreted USGS map units where available, not mineral detections. These are terrain slope indicators, not guarantees of rover safety or route traversability.. Minerals and thermal are simulated overlays.

USGS Mars 2020 CTX DEM. Terrain slopes are calculated between elevation samples. Rocks and other hazards below the raster resolution are outside the model.
